native_measurements.limit: Visible landmarks and dither samples do not uniquely determine the original3D shutter kernel. Sharp estimates are visual ranges; hard-edge fractions are separate measured raster proxies. Corresponding-material patches give observed brightness/dither falloff, not unique physical alpha; overlaps and shading can make the sequence non-monotonic. Mid-frequency retention measures old MICA detail, not total perceived sharpness.
